facts.fact: Wingu Africa, a carrier-neutral colocation operator, says it recently launched its second site in Djibouti, hosting the country's first integrated cable landing station and data centre; its two Djibouti facilities give access to 12 operational submarine cables. No launch date is given, so the release date 2025-06-02 is used.

note: Tier III certification stated is for the Ethiopia campus only; no DJI tier3 fact.
